question_set.question: Use sort_bars with order equal to descending and use filter_subcategories with subcategories_to_remove equal to 1, 2 and use highlight_top_n with n equal to 2 in order to know How do different workout types compare in terms of fat percentage and what role does experience level play?

answer.value: Different workout types show surprisingly similar fat percentages, with Strength training at 25.5%, Cardio at 25.4%, and both HIIT and Yoga at 24.5%. However, experience level reveals dramatic differences: beginners (Level 1) average 27.6% body fat, intermediate (Level 2) at 27.3%, while advanced practitioners (Level 3) show significantly lower fat at 14.8%. This suggests that workout type matters less than consistent experience and dedication. Gender also plays a role, with females averaging 27.7% vs males at 22.6%.

key_insights: Workout types show minimal difference in fat percentage
Experience level 3 shows dramatically lower fat
Gender differences are more pronounced than workout type differences

reasoning_trace.rationale: Sort bars to compare fat percentages across workout types
Filter by experience level to see how it affects results
Highlight top performers to identify best practices
